3605-4808-4890-5131.description:
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Dack's Duplicate by paying {2}{U}{R}, causing it to enter with haste and dethrone as a copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Dance of the Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from the graveyard to the battlefield tapped with Dance of the Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

618-1916-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
618-1916-7272.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Changeling Titan.
When the Changeling Titan token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the Changeling Titan token.
When the Changeling Titan token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Repeat.

4279-4976-6094--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-4976-6094--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch, Open the Graves and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Open the Graves ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

1479-2841-7885-8106.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Myriad Landscape.
There are two basic land cards in your library that share a basic land type.
1479-2841-7885-8106.description:
Fetch a land using Myriad Landscape.
When the fetched land enters, Down in the Valley and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Down in the Valley trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Down in the Valley from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Down in the Valley triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

645-728-1267-6913.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-728-1267-6913.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Chameleon from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Chameleon.
Chameleon triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Chameleon
Repeat each turn.

1981-2034-2403-2415.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

4222-6723-8039.description:
Activate Spireside Infiltrator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Spireside Infiltrator triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Spireside Infiltrator.
Repeat.

1170-1477-5131-5645--202.easyPrerequisites:
Stenn has "Artifact" chosen.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1477-5131-5645--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Stenn.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature
Repeat.

1978-4851-7714.description:
Cast Timeless Lotus by paying its mana cost.
When Timeless Lotus enters, Ultron triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a copy of Timeless Lotus that is a 2/2 Robot Villain creature.
Put the nontoken Timeless Lotus into your graveyard due to the legend rule
During your next turn, activate the Timeless Lotus token by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the Timeless Lotus token.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-2416-3899-4552-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
539-2416-3899-4552-7803.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Rise and Shine
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

5073-5220-6772-6900.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and putting a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

457-1329-6798-7340.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard by paying {U}.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Sewer-veillance Cam, adding {U}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sewer-veillance Cam.
Sewer-veillance Cam triggers, untapping a creature you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.
457-1329-6798-7340.notes: If you control an artifact creature, it can be untapped by the second Sewer-veillance Cam trigger, and then tapped via Urza to get infinite blue mana. Once you have infinite blue mana, you can either use it for Urza's second ability and/or to activate Sewer-veillance Cam's ability to draw cards.

3532-5078-5901-7314.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Baxter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

849-5231-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
849-5231-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Anax and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Anax trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

3259-5484-7175.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander is on the battlefield.
Breath of Fury attached to any creature that isn't your commander.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control
3259-5484-7175.description:
Declare your commander and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
We Ride at Dawn's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Mercenary creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Mercenary token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

3459-4316-5078-6006.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3773-5256-6972--112.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cultivator of Blades.
When Cultivator of Blades dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cultivator of Blades enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.
3773-5256-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Cultivator of Blades's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a charge counter on it

2024-3609-6702.easyPrerequisites: You have a repeatable way to allow Kilo to tap.
2024-3609-6702.description:
Tap Kilo by any method.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{G}{W}, untapping Kilo.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time. Then, repeat steps 1 and 2 one additional time.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
2024-3609-6702.notes: You can use any method(s) to tap Kilo three times per turn. If those methods have additional costs (such as life payments, mana, etc.), then you must pay those costs three times as well.

2034-2267-4365-5220-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-2267-4365-5220-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Tormod triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

2105-6633-6911.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Combat Celebrant has vigilance.
2105-6633-6911.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks and triggering its ability, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Combat Celebrant, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that isn't legendary.
During your next combat phase, declare Combat Celebrant and the Combat Celebrant token as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant token triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has power 1 or greater

262-1379-2034-4853.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Elemental.
When the Elemental dies as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping the creature with Elemental Mastery attached.
Repeat.

3197-3330-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-3330-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-2961-6553.easyPrerequisites: False Demise attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
2292-2961-6553.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, False Demise triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2511-3951-5703-5929.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
2511-3951-5703-5929.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

710-1258-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Danitha, adding one mana of any color.
When Danitha dies, Abduction triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Repeat.

2034-2998-3000-5003.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
2034-2998-3000-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gluttonous Troll, adding {C}{C}.
Gluttonous Troll dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Gluttonous Troll from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Gluttonous Troll enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least two Food artifact tokens and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Squirrel, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2292-2493-3235-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{B}{B}.
2292-2493-3235-3821.description:
During an opponent's combat step, activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{B}{B}.
Cast Wake the Dead by paying {2}{B}{B}, returning Archaeomancer and Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Peregrine Drake and Archaeomancer enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands you control.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Wake the Dead from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Peregrine Drake and Archaeomancer, causing you to scry 1 twice.
Repeat.

1202-2816-4763-5147.description:
Equip Myr Moonvessel with Umbral Mantle.
Sacrifice Myr Moonvessel to Goblin Bombardment to deal 1 damage to any target.
Myr Moonvessel triggers, adding {C}.
Koll triggers, returning Myr Moonvessel to you hand.
Cast Myr Moonvessel.
Repeat.

2199-4944.description:
Activate Frenetic Efreet's ability.
Hold priority and repeat this an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve the Crackdown Construct triggers, making Crackdown Construct arbitrarily large.
